summary.title: Summary
paragraphs: I am a passionate and learning-oriented Frontend Engineer. In my first job, I deeply realized that communication and teamwork are the core drivers of project success. I enjoy working closely with PMs, designers, and backend teammates. In startup challenges, I proactively propose solutions and help the team adopt new technologies and optimize workflows with management support.
Currently seeking the next stage to contribute my skills and continue growing.

work.title: Work Experience
work.overview: During this period, I worked as a Frontend Engineer, collaborating with backend, UI/UX designers, and product managers. I enjoy sharing and communicating. Through team efforts, our project became the only successfully delivered project in the company and received recognition from the technical lead.

manufacturing.title: Smart Manufacturing Project
items: Delivered 13 features on schedule with 100% acceptance rate, ensuring successful system handover
Optimized codebase and resolved 50+ critical bugs, improving system stability by 40%
Migrated project from Webpack to Vite, achieving 83% faster dev startup and 85% faster HMR

agriculture.title: Smart Agriculture Project
items: Took over and planned new project architecture, including components, permissions, folder structure, API, and routing design
Migrated project to Vite and successfully introduced TypeScript, laying a solid foundation for future maintainability and stability

designToken.title: Promoted Design Token Concept
designToken.description: Observed potential pain points in design-dev workflow during collaboration and proactively proposed introducing Design Tokens to management. After gaining approval, I researched and collaborated with designers and management to establish a collaboration model that fits team needs. Hosted a sharing session to explain implementation from a frontend perspective, successfully piloted in the project, and improved design-dev collaboration efficiency.

typescript.title: Introduced TypeScript
typescript.description: To improve long-term project stability, I suggested introducing TypeScript in new projects to management. After gaining support, I successfully applied it to project development through self-learning.

patterns.title: Knowledge Sharing
patterns.description: Established comprehensive development and maintenance documentation for projects (including environment setup, architecture explanations, design patterns), ensuring complete preservation of technical details and reducing subsequent maintenance barriers.

design.title: Addressing Design Resource Shortage
design.description: Under the challenge of limited design resources and tight client deadlines, I proactively took on partial page design work. I collected extensive design inspiration and open-source resources, completed pages without copyright infringement, ultimately gaining client approval and becoming an important part of the product demo.

commercial.title: Overcoming Commercial Software Limitations
commercial.description: To meet client customization needs for Gantt charts, under the situation of no budget for commercial solutions, I actively researched various open-source options. I finally found a highly flexible Gantt chart project, negotiated with PM to confirm feasibility, and successfully developed functionality that met acceptance standards.

items.title: Independent Development Capability
items.description: Able to independently plan project architecture, take over and complete feature development, mastering from design to implementation

items.title: Determination to Overcome Difficulties
items.description: Facing resource constraints and technical challenges, proactively find solutions and execute implementation

items.title: Technology Advocate
items.description: Not only focus on development, but also proactively propose technical improvement suggestions and help team adoption

items.title: Continuous Learning
items.description: Master new technologies through self-learning (such as TypeScript, Design Token) and share with the team

items.title: Cross-functional Collaboration
items.description: Work closely with PMs, designers, and backend engineers to ensure smooth project progress
